tray_state_disk_full: Disk full: audio is not being saved
tray_paste: Add the clipboard to the conversation

listening_unknown: Waiting for the capture helper to confirm.
listening_pause_unconfirmed: Not paused yet: Sondine is still listening.
permission_settings_opened: System Settings is open at the right page.
permissions_waiting: Permissions appear once the capture helper is connected.

error_helper_rejected: The capture helper refused this request.
error_timeout: The capture helper did not answer in time.
analysis_queue_traces: Traces are transcribed only while the model is already loaded for other work.
analysis_queue_traces_server: Traces go to the server after a conversation, or once {count} wait.
analysis_check_retry: Trying again shortly: memory ran short, or a transcription failed.
analysis_check_retry_at: Next try: {time}. Memory ran short, or a transcription failed.
analysis_check_idle: no one has used it for {duration}, or the screen is locked
analysis_check_no_model: No model: see Settings ▸ Transcription model.
analysis_check_hot: It is hot: transcription waits for it to cool down.
analysis_check_pressure_warn: Other apps already use much of the memory.
analysis_check_compressed: macOS compressed {compressed} of memory for lack of room. Below the line ({limit}), pressure should ease: free about {free} by quitting apps.

analysis_check_room: {room} free on disk for swap; {needed} needed.
analysis_check_waived: Off: transcription starts without waiting for it.
analysis_check_ready: Everything is ready: it starts in a few seconds.
analysis_check_nothing: Nothing to transcribe yet: a conversation is transcribed once it ends.

episode_engine: Transcribed by {engine}, a provisional engine until the engines are compared.

forget_description: Everything Sondine heard during that time is erased for good, audio and text. There is no trash.

match.countPlural=other: These {count} iPhone recordings stay: they are not what the Mac heard.

episode_no_match: No match for “{q}” in this transcript.
episode_partial_audio: Part of the audio was missing: {percent}% of the recording was transcribed.
episode_requested_first: Requested: it goes first, even on battery.
episode_retranscribe_requested: New transcript requested: it goes first and will replace this one. Names and your corrections stay.
episode_untranscribed_failed: Transcription failed. You can try again.
episode_untranscribed_no_model: No transcription model is installed: the audio is kept and can be played, and transcription waits for the model.
episode_untranscribed_open: Still recording: transcription starts when it ends. You can already listen to it.
episode_live_note: Live text, approximate: the final transcript will replace it.
episode_untranscribed_waiting: Not transcribed yet. Sondine transcribes while the Mac is plugged in and idle, or right away when you ask.
episode_waiting_other_running: Not transcribed yet · another transcription is running and this one waits its turn. You can move it first.
episode_waiting_because: Not transcribed yet · {reason}. You can also transcribe it right away.
episode_speech_heard: Speech heard: {duration}, marked on the player bar.
listening_write_error: Capture goes on, but the audio cannot be saved.
model_disk_short: The download needs {needed} of free space (the model and room for recording); {free} is left.
model_download_note: Downloaded from Hugging Face, only when you start it. Free space: {free}.
model_import_clones: The import makes no copy: no extra disk space.
model_import_copies: The import copies the file: {size} of extra disk space.
model_low_memory: This Mac has less memory than the model asks for: it may wait or be slow.
model_pick_busy: Something is already running for this model.
model_problem_bad_response: The server sent an invalid answer.
model_problem_corrupt: The installed model is damaged. Import or download it again.
model_problem_hash_mismatch: This file is not the expected model.
model_problem_io: Cannot write to the models folder.
model_problem_network: The connection dropped. The download resumes where it stopped.
model_problem_not_a_file: This file is gone, or it is not a file.
model_problem_redirect_refused: The server redirected to an address that is not allowed.
model_problem_size_mismatch: This file does not have the expected model’s size.
model_problem_too_large: The server sent more than the model’s size.
model_requirements: {size} · needs a Mac with {memory} of memory · this Mac: {mac}
player_nothing: Nothing to hear in this recording.
player_keys_hint: Space: play or pause · ← →: 5 s · ↑ ↓: previous or next sentence
queue_reason_dictation_next: dictation, transcribed on this Mac in a moment
queue_reason_not_idle: resumes when the Mac is idle
queue_reason_on_battery: resumes when the Mac is plugged in
queue_reason_power_and_idle: resumes when the Mac is plugged in and idle
queue_reason_server_next: goes to the server in a moment
queue_reason_server_quota: this month’s hours are used up
queue_reason_server_trace: very short: goes to the server with the next conversation, or once {count} wait
queue_reason_swap: waits for the Mac to stop swapping
queue_reason_thermal: waits for the Mac to cool down
request_waiting_after_running: It goes right after the transcription under way.
request_waiting_behind: It goes right after another request, which waits for the Mac.
request_failed_invalid_output: The model wrote text it could not match to the audio, even in small pieces.
request_failed_model_limit: A passage is longer than the model can write in one go, even in small pieces.
sidebar_disk_full_detail: Audio is no longer saved. Free up space on the Mac.
commitments_description: What you promised and what you were promised, found by the journal in your conversations of the last 90 days.
commitments_off: The journal is off: it is what finds commitments.
commitments_none_done: No commitment done in the last 90 days.
voice_self_hint: The voice heard most on the microphone during the call: an assumption, not a recognition.
welcome_already_listening: Listening already started from the menu bar.
welcome_menu_bar: Sondine’s icon in the menu bar shows whether it listens. A click pauses it for 15 minutes, an hour, or until you resume.
welcome_microphone_use: Conversations in person, and your voice in calls.
welcome_system_audio_use: The other side of calls, videos and music.
welcome_model_continues: You can continue: it goes on in the background.
welcome_model_intro: On this Mac, transcription needs this model. Without it, Sondine still records, and transcribes later.
welcome_no_microphone_note: Without the microphone, Sondine hears only the Mac’s sound.
welcome_no_model_note: Without a model, nothing is transcribed for now: the audio is kept.
welcome_no_system_audio_note: Without system audio, Sondine hears only the microphone.
welcome_permissions_intro: macOS asks for your consent for each source. Nothing is recorded until you start listening.
welcome_restricted: The system prevents Sondine from using it (managed Mac).
welcome_start_intro: Once you start, Sondine records the microphone and the Mac’s sound, and goes on until you pause.
welcome_transcription_when: Transcription runs while the Mac is plugged in and idle, or right away when you ask.
export_stale: The recording just changed: try again.
voice_name_placeholder: A name, or someone already named
people_empty: No one is named yet. In a conversation, click a voice (“Voice 1”) above the transcript to say who it is.
people_merge_description: The person you pick is {name} under another name: their conversations and voice join {name}, who keeps this name. ⌘Z undoes it.
people_delete_description: Their voices read “Voice 1”, “Voice 2”… again in every conversation. The recordings and their transcripts stay.
voice_recognized: Recognized at 99% or more, to confirm
settings_recognition_on: Sondine suggests a name for voices that sound like the ones you named. Only you confirm. Voice prints stay on this Mac.
settings_recognition_off: Voices read “Voice 1”, “Voice 2”… Voice prints are erased; your names come back if you turn it on again.
settings_voice_dictations: Learn my voice from my dictations
settings_voice_dictations_on: Your dictations, where you speak alone, help Sondine recognise your voice.
settings_voice_dictations_off: Your dictations are not used to recognize you; their voice prints are erased.
settings_notch_hover_on: During a call, the pointer on the notch shows the call and your last conversations with the person. Visible if you share your screen.
settings_notch_hover_off: During a call, a click on the notch shows the call and your last conversations with the person.
settings_live_detail: A small model (1.3 GB) writes each sentence a few seconds after, on power. The final transcript replaces it.
settings_live_no_model: Install its model below to start.
settings_live_blocked: Paused until the next launch: an old transcription process could not be stopped.
settings_live_on_battery: Paused: the Mac is on battery.
settings_dictation_text_detail: Sondine keeps exactly what {app} typed, read from its history on this Mac and never changed. Anything missing there is transcribed here.
settings_dictation_detail: What you say to a dictation app is kept apart, with your voice only. Known dictation apps count by default.
settings_dictation_none: No app has listened to the microphone outside a call yet.
settings_dictation_pick_message: Choose the dictation app to add
settings_browser_switch: Know which page plays the sound
settings_browser_detail: On a page that plays sound, the extension reads its address, its title and whether it can be heard, and on YouTube where the video is, its length, its speed and whether an ad plays; never the page’s text or what you type. It sends them only to Sondine, on this Mac.
settings_browser_unavailable: This build of Sondine has no extension.
settings_browser_outdated: Extension {version}: reload it in {browser} to get {current}.
settings_browser_steps: In the browser, open the extensions, turn on developer mode, then « Load unpacked » and choose the folder Sondine shows.
settings_browser_access: The browser will say it can read all sites: that is what it needs to see the pages that play sound.
settings_browser_show: Show the extension in the Finder
episode_site_left_out: {site} is no longer kept: from now on, what it plays is deleted at the end, before it is transcribed.
imports_drop_hint: Drop files here, or copy them in Finder and paste them (⌘V).
imports_failed_unreadable: This file is not audio the Mac can read.
imports_failed_too_long: This recording is longer than 4 hours.
imports_failed_disk_full: Not enough room on the disk for this recording.
episode_also_recorded_open: Open the recording of the same moment, at the same second
episode_journal_reads_other: the journal reads the other one
episode_journal_use_this: Use this one in the journal
imports_phone_filed: iPhone recording: it is in Today, at the hour it was made.
imports_phone_already: This iPhone recording is already here.
imports_failed_conflict: Another iPhone recording already has this number. The file was not imported.
imports_failed_deleted: This iPhone recording was deleted on this Mac; it does not come back.
people_unnamed_hint: Voices from the last 30 days, without a name. Click a voice to say who it is.
people_doubts_hint: You named these voices, but they sound more like someone else.
agents_access_off: No agent can read your conversations.
agents_access_on: Connected agents read your transcripts and the names of voices, never the audio. Every read shows here.
agents_confirm_description: A connected agent, such as Claude Code, Codex or Grok, will be able to search and read all your transcripts, the names you gave voices and when your conversations happened. What it reads goes to its provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI…). It cannot listen to the audio or change anything, and you can cut its access at any time.
agents_no_relay: This build of Sondine cannot connect agents.
agents_command_description: Paste this command in a terminal, then restart {name}. It holds this agent’s key, shown only once: do not share it.
agents_command_hint: A command to paste in a terminal
agents_other_hint: JSON or TOML settings to copy
agents_consent_app: Sondine creates a key for {name} and adds its server to {path}, leaving the rest of the file as it is and keeping a copy of it. Revoking the key removes that server.
agents_consent_command: Sondine creates a key for {name} and gives you the command that adds it there.
agents_consent_other: Sondine creates a key for this app and gives you the server to add to its MCP settings.
agents_consent_reads: The agent will be able to search and read all your transcripts, the names of voices, your journal and what you added to conversations, never the audio.
agents_consent_leaves_provider: What it reads goes to its model’s provider ({provider}), which handles it under its own rules: Sondine cannot take it back.
agents_consent_leaves: What it reads goes to its model’s provider, which handles it under its own rules: Sondine cannot take it back.
agents_consent_shared: {apps} also reads this file and will be able to read Sondine with this key; what it reads goes to its model’s provider.
agents_app_replaces: {name} also read a server of that name from {path}: it now takes this one, with its own key.
agents_app_reload: Reopen {name}, or start a new session, so it sees it.
agents_app_problem_taken: {path} already has a server of that name, which is not Sondine’s.
agents_app_problem_unsafe: Sondine cannot add its server to {path} without touching the rest of the file.
agents_app_untouched: The file did not change. “Another app” gives the server to add by hand.
agents_other_description: Add this server to the app’s MCP settings: under “mcpServers” in JSON, under “mcp_servers” in TOML. It holds this app’s key, shown only once: do not share it.
agents_remove_failed: Key revoked, but Sondine could not remove its server from {path}: remove it by hand.
undo_changed: Couldn’t undo: the conversation changed since.
redo_changed: Couldn’t redo: the conversation changed since.
passage_explain: From {from} to {to}: the text and audio are erased for good.
settings_login_item_hint: Sondine listens as soon as you log in to the Mac, without you opening it.
context_field_placeholder: A note, or a pasted link…
context_pick_message: Choose the files to add to the conversation
context_removed: Removed from the context. ⌘Z puts it back.
context_removed_transcribed: Removed from the context. Its transcript stays in Imported. ⌘Z puts it back.
context_shortcut_hint: From any app, ⌃⌥⌘V adds the clipboard to the conversation going on.
context_clipboard_empty: Nothing to add on the clipboard.
context_problem_too_long: note too long (20,000 characters at most)
context_problem_too_many: 20 files at a time at most
chat_off: Chatting with an agent is off.
chat_leaves: Your message and what the agent reads in Sondine go to {provider}.
chat_provider_missing: Claude Code is not installed on this Mac.
chat_provider_signed_out: Claude Code is not signed in. Run “claude” in a terminal to sign in.
chat_provider_unsupported: This version of Claude Code is too old for Sondine. Update it with “claude update”.
chat_no_relay: This version of Sondine cannot let an agent read it.
chat_failure_signed_out: Claude Code is signed out. Run “claude” in a terminal to sign in again.
chat_failure_usage_limit: Your plan’s limit is reached for now.
chat_failure_context_full: This chat is too long for the model. Start a new one.
chat_failure_unavailable: The agent did not answer. Try again in a moment.
chat_failure_crashed: The agent stopped. Your next message starts it again.
chat_failure_refused_tool: The agent offered a tool that is not Sondine’s, so Sondine stopped it.
chat_failure_protocol: Sondine could not read the agent’s answer.
chat_access: Chat with an agent in Sondine
chat_access_off: Nothing of Sondine goes to an AI provider.
chat_access_on: Your messages and what the agent reads go to Anthropic, with your subscription. Chats stay on this Mac.
chat_confirm_description: What you write, and what the agent reads in Sondine to answer you (transcripts, names of voices, context added to conversations, files and images included), goes to Anthropic with your Claude subscription. The agent only reads: it cannot listen to audio, change anything, or use any other tool. What was sent cannot be called back, even if you delete the conversation later. Nothing is sent without a message from you.
settings_privacy_intro: By default Sondine keeps everything. Each private zone takes something away; zones add up.
settings_privacy_default_same: Audio and text · audio {days} days, text always
settings_privacy_default_range: Audio and text · audio {min} to {max} days by type, text always
privacy_detail_dropped: deleted when it ends, before any transcription
privacy_screen_detail: Locked, screen saver, or display asleep
privacy_app_detail: Sound, calls and dictations, microphone included
privacy_add_network_hint: The one you are on, without asking for your location

match.countPlural=one: The audio of 1 recording will be deleted; its text stays.
match.countPlural=other: The audio of {count} recordings will be deleted; their text stays.

journal_no_model: The daily journal and commitments are written on this Mac by a local language model.
journal_no_commitments_mine: No open commitments of yours or to you in the last 7 days.
settings_journal: Write the daily journal and the list of commitments
settings_journal_detail: A model reads the transcribed conversations and notes what happened and who committed to what, each line citing its sentence. It runs on power, Mac idle.
journal_claude_paused: Claude did not answer (connection, account or limits): the journal tries again in a few minutes.
settings_journal_writer_device_detail: The model on this Mac writes everything. Nothing leaves the Mac.
settings_journal_writer_checked: This Mac, read again by Claude
settings_journal_writer_checked_detail: The model on this Mac writes, then your Claude reads each commitment again with the sentences around it. Those sentences go to Anthropic.
settings_journal_writer_claude_detail: Your Claude (Haiku) writes the journal and reads its commitments again. The transcribed conversations go to Anthropic.
settings_journal_writer_confirm_checked: For each commitment found, the sentences around it (about ten lines, other people's voices included) will go to Anthropic, with the Claude Code subscription signed in on this Mac. What is sent cannot be called back, even by deleting the conversation later. This choice applies to what is written next, and « This Mac » stays available at any time.
settings_journal_writer_confirm_claude: Every transcribed conversation, other people's voices included, will go to Anthropic to be written, with the Claude Code subscription signed in on this Mac. What is sent cannot be called back, even by deleting the conversation later. This choice applies to what is written next, and « This Mac » stays available at any time.
settings_phone_on: At home, the iPhone sends its recordings to this Mac, then erases their audio. It can read the Mac’s memory without keeping it; each read is counted below.
settings_phone_unavailable: This build of Sondine cannot sync an iPhone.
settings_phone_revoke_description: It can no longer send or read anything. At its next contact, it erases its access and the results it kept, and keeps the recordings it has not sent yet.
settings_phone_pair_scan: On the iPhone, open Sondine ▸ Mac ▸ Scan the code.
settings_phone_pair_asked: « {name} » wants to pair. Are the digits the same on the iPhone?
settings_phone_pair_failed: The Mac could not open the pairing.
settings_phone_tailnet_detail: Away from home, the iPhone reaches this Mac through Tailscale, encrypted: Tailscale knows the two devices talk, not what they say.
settings_phone_tailnet_learn: Tailscale must run on this Mac and on the iPhone. Open Sondine on the iPhone once at home: it learns the Mac’s Tailscale address there.
settings_phone_reset_description: The Mac takes a new key and every iPhone is revoked. To sync again, pair each one with a new code, at home.
welcome_voice_intro: Read this text aloud, at your own pace: Sondine will recognize your voice from today.
voice_read_privacy: The voice print stays on this Mac and the recording is deleted at once.
voice_read_text: Sondine listens for me, and only on this Mac. This morning I had a coffee with Leah before cycling to the office. It was a little chilly, but the sky was clear above the rooftops. We talked about the trip in June, the train tickets, a hotel near the sea and the plan for each day. Tonight I will read my notes again and choose the best date.
voice_read_recording_hint: Sondine stops by itself at the end. Listening to the microphone resumes afterwards.
voice_read_quiet: Speak a little louder, or move closer to the Mac.
voice_read_none: Read a short text so Sondine recognizes your voice without waiting for your first conversations.
voice_read_recognition_off: Voice recognition is off: Sondine learns no voice.
voice_read_no_microphone: Sondine cannot use the microphone. Allow it in System Settings ▸ Privacy & Security ▸ Microphone.
voice_read_unavailable: This build of Sondine cannot record a read.
voice_read_too_short: Sondine heard too little voice. Start again and read the whole text.
voice_read_failed: The read could not be recorded. Try again.
settings_call_offers: Notify me when a call starts
settings_call_offers_detail: The notch shows the call, with a switch to listen to it or not. Without a notch, a notification offers it.
call_offer_body: Sondine is paused. Listen to this call? The pause comes back when the call ends.
settings_call_notice_silent: Sondine’s notifications do not appear on screen.
call_notice_title: Sondine is listening to this call
today_beside: Commitments, calendar and people of the day
agent_limit_off: The agent starts here and can read your other conversations.
agent_limit_on: The agent reads only this. Sondine refuses the rest.
backup_save_message: Choose where to save the backup
backup_pick_message: Choose the Sondine backup to restore
backup_sizes: On this Mac: database {database} · audio {audio} · context {context}
backup_export_intro: All of Sondine in one file: conversations, transcripts, voices and people, journal, context, settings, paired iPhones and compute servers. Models are not in it: they download again.
backup_export_what: The file holds everything that was said and the voices. Keep it somewhere safe.
backup_include_audio_detail: Without audio, the backup keeps the text, the voices and everything else, and is much smaller.
backup_with_passphrase_detail: Encrypted: without the passphrase, no one can read it.
backup_without_passphrase_detail: Readable by whoever finds the file.
backup_without_passphrase_warning: Without a passphrase, everything that was said, the voices and the Cloud token will be readable by whoever finds the file.
backup_passphrase_lost: A lost passphrase cannot be recovered: keep it in your password manager.
backup_export_progress_detail: Sondine keeps listening during the backup.
backup_export_keep_passphrase: Without its passphrase, this file cannot be restored.
backup_export_stale: Something was deleted during the backup, so it was discarded. Start it again.
backup_export_failed: The backup could not be written.
backup_no_space_short: Not enough space on this Mac.
backup_busy: A backup or a restore is already running.
backup_restore_intro: Replaces this Mac’s data with a backup’s. The current data is kept aside until you delete it.
backup_restore_what_replace: Choose a .sondine file. Nothing is replaced before you confirm.
backup_restore_what_first: Choose a .sondine file to get everything back at once. Sondine will restart on it.
backup_restore_replace_warning: All of this Mac’s data will be replaced. It is kept aside and can be recovered until you delete it in Settings ▸ Data.
backup_restore_progress_detail: Sondine is reading and checking the backup.
backup_restore_failed: The restore could not be done. Nothing was replaced.
backup_not_a_backup: This file is not a Sondine backup.
backup_damaged: This backup is damaged or incomplete. Nothing was replaced.
backup_newer: This backup comes from a newer version of Sondine: update Sondine first.
backup_previous_delete_title: Delete the data from before the restore?
backup_previous_delete_detail: It will be erased from this Mac for good.
backup_restored_detail: Everything is back, as it was on {date}.
backup_restored_paused: Listening is paused until you resume it.
backup_restored_permissions: macOS may ask again for the microphone and system audio.
backup_restored_phones: If the old Mac is still in use, revoke its iPhones on one of the two.
backup_swap_failed_detail: Sondine stops so that nothing is lost: the data stayed as it is in {folder}. Write to us before opening Sondine again.
stats_people: Who you talk with most, 30 days
imports_done: Recording imported. Sondine is transcribing it.
welcome_goal_title: What do you want to find again?
welcome_goal_meetings_detail: What was said in meetings and on the phone.
welcome_goal_everything_detail: Also the videos and music heard.
welcome_cloud_title: This Mac does not have enough memory for the transcription model.
welcome_cloud_how_detail: It only runs if you turn it on. The audio is sent encrypted, transcribed, then erased. The text comes back to this Mac, and everything else stays here.
welcome_others: The voices around you are recorded too; tell people when the law asks you to.
voice_merge_hint: The same person as {name}: their passages join one voice. ⌘Z undoes it.

match.countPlural=one: It comes off {count} recording. The recording stays.
match.countPlural=other: It comes off {count} recordings. The recordings stay.

compute_beta_bad_link: This invite link or code is not valid.
compute_beta_busy: Too many requests from this connection today. Try again tomorrow.
compute_beta_closed: The open beta is closed. Paste an invite link or code if you have one.
compute_beta_detail: A Synapsr server: 60 minutes free, then by subscription.
compute_beta_full: All places are taken. Write to us for what comes next.
compute_beta_honour: We give our word that we do not read or listen to your data, and it trains no model.
compute_beta_others: The audio also contains the voices of the people you talk with. This server is not reserved for Sondine: software agents of Synapsr have administrator access to it and could, too, technically access the audio and the text during transcription. The server keeps when your access was last used, the length transcribed and, if you subscribe, your Stripe customer and subscription identifiers. Cloudflare carries the connection and sees your IP address, not the audio.
compute_beta_quota: This Cloud link has no quota left.
compute_beta_refused: This invite link or code is not recognized or was revoked.
compute_beta_secure: Want a secure cloud that even we cannot access?
compute_beta_what: The audio of your finished conversations is sent encrypted to a Synapsr server, which transcribes it, then erases it. It is held in memory only, but during transcription, the people and programs that administer this server could technically access it and the text. What is sent cannot be called back.
compute_connect_bad_link: This is not a Sondine machine’s link.
compute_connect_refused: This machine does not know this link. Make a new one on it.
compute_device_detail: The audio does not leave the Mac.
compute_mismatch: This is not the expected server, or it runs another version than Sondine.
compute_own_confirm: The audio of your finished conversations will be sent encrypted to your machine, other people’s voices included, and the text comes back here. The people and programs that administer that machine can technically access it and the text during computation. What is sent cannot be called back. “This Mac” stays available at any time.
compute_own_detail: Another computer of yours, powerful enough for the model.
episode_private_zone: Private zone: this recording is not sent to a server.
usage_what: One report a day, made of counts: features used, setup step, errors. Never a conversation, a name or a time.
diagnostic_what: Nothing but this text. It leaves from your own mailbox, to {email}.
diagnostic_issue: Or open a public issue on GitHub
update_what: At most every other day, Sondine looks for a new version on GitHub, which sees your IP address. It checks who signed it and installs it when nothing is going on. Otherwise, you look for it yourself.
update_search_only: For now, Sondine only looks for new versions, and downloads nothing.
update_wait_call: Sondine {version} is ready. It will install after the call.
update_wait_dictation: Sondine {version} is ready. It will install after the dictation.
update_wait_conversation: Sondine {version} is ready. It will install after the recording in progress.
update_wait_transcription: Sondine {version} is ready. It will install after the transcription in progress.
update_wait_sync: Sondine {version} is ready. It will install once the iPhone is done.
update_wait_task: Sondine {version} is ready. It will install once Sondine is done with what it does.
update_wait_in_use: Sondine {version} is ready. It will install once the Mac has been idle for a few minutes.
update_problem_network: GitHub did not answer. Check the connection.
update_problem_refused: GitHub refuses to answer for now. Try again later.
update_problem_bad_response: GitHub gave an answer Sondine cannot read.
update_problem_disk_full: Not enough room on the disk for the update.
update_problem_corrupt: The file received is not the one published. Nothing was installed.
update_problem_signature: This version is not signed by Sondine’s developer. Nothing was installed.
update_problem_notarization: This version was not checked by Apple. Nothing was installed.
update_problem_macos: This version asks for a later macOS.
update_problem_version: The file received is not the version announced. Nothing was installed.
update_problem_install: This version could not be installed. Download it from its page.
update_blocked_move: For it to update itself, move Sondine to Applications.
update_blocked_test_copy: This copy does not update itself: it is not named “Sondine”.
update_blocked_unreleased: This build does not update itself: it is not a published version.
update_blocked_development: A development build does not update itself.
update_not_started_body: Sondine is not listening. Download this version from its page and put it back in Applications: your data has not moved.
vocabulary_intro: Sondine spells these words your way when a transcript hears a word that looks like one of them. A note helps the journal’s model recognize it.
vocabulary_people: Your People’s names are part of it too: {names}.
vocabulary_no_model: Without the journal’s model, only words that sound the same are corrected.
vocabulary_unheard_description: It does not sound like what was heard, so Sondine does not learn it from this correction.
compute_trial_terms: No card, no account. Then 19 € a month for 40 h.
cloud_wave_full_detail: All places of wave 1 are taken. Leave your address for the next one, or transcribe on your own machine.
cloud_trial_done: Your trial is over. What waits to be transcribed goes as soon as you subscribe.
cloud_founder_detail: 40 h of transcription a month. The price stays at 19 € as long as the subscription lasts (regular price: 29 €).
cloud_ends_detail: You keep your hours until {date}, then your top-up hours.
cloud_past_due_detail: The last payment failed. Stripe will try again, and transcription goes on meanwhile.
cloud_ended_detail: Your subscription has ended. You can subscribe again as long as you keep your place.
cloud_period_done: This period’s hours are used. They come back on {date}.
cloud_stripe_note: Card, invoices and cancellation are managed on Stripe’s secure page, in your browser.
cloud_waiting: Finish on the Stripe page open in your browser. This page updates by itself.
cloud_not_allowed: That is not possible for your place right now.
cloud_unavailable: Payment does not answer. Try again in a moment.
cloud_reference_detail: Give it with any request about your place, an erasure for instance. It cannot be used to transcribe.
compute_trial_summary: The audio of your finished conversations goes encrypted to a Synapsr server, which transcribes it, then erases it. During transcription, its administrators, software agents included, could technically access it. We commit to reading and listening to nothing, and nothing trains a model.
